Owner must preserve prior escalated rows before replacement and supply actual readiness reasoning/dependencies; record grants no independent acceptance or gate waiver.

No manifest changes are presently needed: its current labels already match the independently computed batch1 graph.

Run scoped metadata/format/render checks against exactly changed owned items after final edits and proof-layout as required. Do not reformat unchanged bodies as part of the scalar patch. Native run-wide item-dependency-levels check and the complete Step1 battery wait until all ordinary inputs/writers are ready.

Root records a concise metadata-only reconciliation evidence receipt describing old/current run label contexts and unchanged body/interfaces, with actual pre/post hashes owned by root. Keep historical publication evidence unchanged: it records the earlier accepted publication, not a fresh review of successor bytes. This evidence is not a verification.repair receipt and grants no new scientific acceptance.

After actual readiness prerequisites, contracts and placement are checked and writers drain, root invokes recordStep1Batch for the 19 rows with decision ready, owner true, concrete reasons and the actually examined dependency IDs. Refresh any other current readiness/certification whose dependency closure changed; do not merely rewrite a hash or reuse earlier acceptance as current review. Then native owner preparation and full required gates proceed.
patch_shape: For each inventory row, replace only the unique top-level line dependency_level: SOURCE_LEVEL with dependency_level: SUCCESSOR_LEVEL. Fail closed on missing/duplicate lines, unexpected current scalar, changed body or active writer. This is an owner-applied scalar metadata edit; no native --write command exists.
affected_consumers: The full 19-item inventory includes the batch1 suppliers and their same-batch consumers. No Statement/Definition/physical interface changes are proposed, so CLAUDE consumer scientific-repair propagation is not triggered. Current hash-bound readiness and certifications for every direct or indirect dependency consumer can nevertheless become stale and must be recaptured by root after actual checks. Outside/unfinished consumer inventories are not certified by this report.
risks: Any author or other writer changes after capture can invalidate proposed levels and readiness. Recheck complete current manifests after drain; do not run global level validation on incomplete inventories and treat failure as scientific defect.

dependency_level participates in raw, guard and judge hashes and frontier readiness hashes; no hash exclusion exists for this metadata. Metadata-only scope does not make those bindings remain current.

Existing verification.verified blocks are historical publication provenance and must not be relabelled as current independent review. No currently hash-bound acceptance is created by this report or by readiness recording.

The quotation parser defect affects frontier selection/buildability and also exists in drift-review-check publication scanning. Root should separately repair/test/document that native parsing defect without using status edits to conceal it. It does not require discarding valid active authoring work.

The carrier dependency_level is a single persistent field while levels are run-relative. Reusing a published item in later scopes can require another metadata reconciliation; this proposal does not redesign that policy.
